---
title: "Emacs"
---

Emacs asks the most and gives the most. Nearly everything is reachable from the
keyboard and nearly everything can be redefined, but you have to learn the
keybindings, and customising it means writing Lisp.

The [Emacs guide](../emacs/index.qmd) covers installation, the IQSS
configuration, moving around, editing, and a commands list to keep beside you.
